pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/48097

Change semantic model analysis to use a `Stack<T>` instead of recursion. This removes the possibility of running out of stack and causing a stack overflow in files with deeply nested node graphs.

issue_context.title: RoutePatternAnalyzer causes stack overflow on C# file with a lot of string operations

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

A file with a lot of string `+` operations (generated code) causes a stack overflow in the route pattern analyzer.

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/a5833f771a387df53bb0cc71a99c36e5b38c728d/src/Framework/AspNetCoreAnalyzers/src/Analyzers/RouteEmbeddedLanguage/RoutePatternAnalyzer.cs#L52

clean compile

```
git clone https://github.com/timmydo/dotnet8p3analyzer1.git
cd dotnet8p3analyzer1
dotnet build
```

@jaredpar Thanks. Yeah, this definitely needs to change.

I have a PR - https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/48105. There are some comments about using `DescendantTokens()`. Will probably do something slightly different because we want to use `FilteredSpan` optimization in the future.
I created https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/68136. The JSON analyzer uses recursion and I copied the implementation.
